user_prompt.search_conclusion: Please analyze the provided web content and extract the information most relevant to the user's question: 1. Reformat the web page into human readable version, provide the raw data, do not miss any useful information. 2. Ensure no fabrication. 3. Give some urls which are related to the user's question. Return the result in JSON format, e.g., {{'content': content,'urls': [{{'title':title,'url':url,'description':description}},{{'title':title,'url':url,'description':description}},...],'score': score}}, where 'content' is the core content related to the user's question(limit in 200 words), url must be related to the user's question. Description:If the url is a paper, it's the description of this paper according to the origin query. You must reflect on whether this checklist has checked all the key points in the origin query. If not, you need to supplement this checklist. Check each item on the checklist to see if the paper meets the requirements and provide supporting evidence of the paper for each checklist (limit in 200 words). If the url is a webpage, it's the description of the web. If there are paper URLs related to the user's question, they must be all returned. If there is no related url, return empty list. 'score' is the relevance score between 0 and 1, indicating how relevant the web content is to the user's question. The URL, title, and content must correspond exactly; otherwise, it's better not to output anything at all. You must limit the overall response to within 1000 words. The user's question is: {user}, origin query:{origin_query}, checklist:{checklist} and the web content is: {info}.
